title: Restore owner literals the CEO paraphrases out of delegated workstream goals
description: BASE 44e4bc5. Production defect: the CEO LLM paraphrases workstream goals and drops statement literals (URLs, /api routes, filenames, quoted keys) — delegated children inherit the paraphrased goal verbatim, so agents see 'the specified API' and fail closed or guess. Fix: deterministic src/pair/objective-source-terms.ts extracts literals (URL/Win-path/route/filename/quoted/storage-key; statement order, deduped, <=24 x <=160 chars) and appendMissingSourceTerms() projects them onto P14 child specs inside decomposeObjective before commit: clause-match >=2 token overlap attributes literals, unclaimed go to EVERY workstream, a workstream claiming nothing gets the FULL set (F1: no confident-but-wrong sibling starvation), verbatim literals never duplicate, goal+trailer > 2048 fails closed atomically. normalized_proposal_digest covers the RAW proposal (replay/amend unchanged); the P14 WDEC proposal_digest covers the ENRICHED goal. Files: src/pair/objective-source-terms.ts (new), objective-workstream.ts (+11/-1), index.ts (+1), src/__tests__/pair-p15-2w-source-terms.test.ts (new, 21 tests: extraction/order/dedupe/prose-safety/caps, clause match + fallbacks (F1), no-dup, 2048 fail-closed + zero-residue rollback, |]/newline safety, raw-vs-enriched digests (F2), amend cannot alter committed graph (F2), 3-URL + 'same as X' e2e, replay convergence, DC->DL propagation (F3)). Executed: 21/21 pass; pair-p15-2 31/31 pass; tsc clean. Enrichment only restores owner-typed text; no merge claimed.
